metric_correction.actual_quantity: mean absolute confidence-correctness error over individual samples
metric_correction.formal_ece_status: not computed in Phase 16; do not cite 0.0311 as ECE

evidence_boundary: Selective prediction is demonstrated only on the PlantVillage random held-out test protocol. It is not farm, season, cultivar, device, severity, or early-stage validation. Threshold selection was not calibrated on an independent validation artifact in this kernel, so results remain diagnostic rather than final deployment thresholds.
next_gate: OOD detection with explicit score comparison and threshold selection on validation data
